old_caption: The video captures a mesmerizing display of flames against a stark black background. The flames, primarily in shades of orange and yellow, dance and flicker with varying intensities. They rise and fall rhythmically, creating a dynamic and captivating visual effect. The flames appear to be from a single source, possibly a candle or a small fire, and they move fluidly, with some flames curling upwards while others spread outwards. The contrast between the bright, vibrant flames and the deep blackness of the background enhances the dramatic and almost hypnotic quality of the scene. There is no discernible change in the environment or introduction of new elements throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent focus on the natural beauty and power of fire.

caption: The video captures three separate tongues of orange-yellow flame rising from the bottom edge against a uniform black background, placed at the left, center, and right. With bright yellow-white edges and darker orange interiors, the flames continuously flicker, curl, and deform as their tips stretch and bend. Through the earlier portion the left and center columns stand tall, the left repeatedly forming a hooked crown while the right stays low near the bottom-right edge. As the excerpt progresses the left and center tongues shrink toward the bottom into short wavering stubs. Meanwhile the right flame grows into a taller defined column, its tip curling upward higher than before. The horizontal placement of the three columns remains roughly constant with no camera movement, and no object enters or leaves the frame as their relative prominence shifts.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.

or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
